observations: Two red boxes labeled 'Wireless Controller' are placed on top of a white console.
The boxes feature an image of a white controller with a central analog stick and a D-pad.
A black power cable with a UK-style 3-pin plug is visible.
A black HDMI cable is coiled in front of the boxes.
The console itself is white and appears to be a standard PlayStation 4 model.
A watermark 'GAME ARENAOFFICIAL' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The console in photo 0 is a standard PS4 model, not the Pro. The 'Pro' designation is not visible on the console or packaging.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may be a standard PS4 rather than a PS4 Pro, which significantly affects its value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console's model label or the bottom of the unit showing the 'PS4 Pro' designation.

risks.risk: The controller shown in the box may be a generic third-party product rather than an official Sony accessory.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller outside of its packaging.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic third-party controller

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have a faulty disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, navigating the system menu, and successfully reading a game disc.

proof_requests: Photo of the sticker on the back of the console showing the model number.
Photo of the console's model label or bottom plate to confirm if it is a PS4 Pro.
Photo of the controller outside of its box to verify authenticity.
Video of the console booting up and playing a game.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
